description: This file defines an interface for handling complex observations (Obs) in the OpenMRS medical record system. It specifies methods for saving, retrieving, and deleting complex data associated with observations, as well as obtaining supported view types.

classes.name: ComplexObsHandler
classes.description: An interface for managing storage and retrieval of complex medical observation data within OpenMRS. Implementing classes handle different data storage mechanisms for complex observations.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Stores the complex data associated with 'Obs' to a specific location via the handler, then nullifies the complex data in the Obs object and returns it.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves complex data from storage for a given Obs object in a specified view format, attaching the data back to the Obs.

methods.name: purgeComplexData
methods.description: Removes the complex data object from storage, effectively deleting the associated data for the given Obs.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns all view types supported by this handler implementation.

methods.name: supportsView
methods.description: Checks if a specific view type is supported by this handler.
